answer: LIST round((THE DISTINCT COUNT OF Player [has PlayerBirthday b] [is api of PlayerAttribute has PlayerAttributeDefensiveWorkRate: 'high'] WHERE year(b) >= 1991) * 100 / (THE DISTINCT COUNT OF Player [has PlayerBirthday b2] [is api of PlayerAttribute has PlayerAttributeDefensiveWorkRate w] WHERE year(b2) >= 1991 AND (w = 'low' OR w = 'medium' OR w = 'high')), 2)
note: Graded = low/medium/high only (17.41); counting every stored value gives 17.07.

DEFINE Cur ::= LIST t, md FROM Team t AND ALSO is api of TeamAttribute has TeamAttributeDate d WHERE d <= '2014-09-19 23:59:59' AND ALSO THE MAXIMUM d GROUPED BY t AS md
LIST sn, c, v FROM Team t has TeamShortName sn AND ALSO [is api of TeamAttribute has TeamAttributeChanceCreationPassingClass: 'Risky'] AND ALSO t has Cur CurMd md AND ALSO is api of TeamAttribute a has TeamAttributeDate md AND ALSO a has TeamAttributeChanceCreationPassing p AND ALSO THE DISTINCT COUNT OF t GROUPED BY sn AS c AND ALSO THE AVERAGE p GROUPED BY sn AS av AND ALSO round(av, 1) AS v WHERE c > 1 ORDERED WITH av DESCENDING, sn ASCENDING
note: In force = latest attribute row on or before 2014-09-19.

DEFINE Last ::= LIST p, md FROM Player p AND ALSO is api of PlayerAttribute a has PlayerAttributeDefensiveWorkRate w AND ALSO a has PlayerAttributeDate d WHERE (w = 'low' OR w = 'medium' OR w = 'high') AND ALSO THE MAXIMUM d GROUPED BY p AS md
LIST round(THE AVERAGE h IN (Player p has PlayerBirthday b AND ALSO has PlayerHeight h AND ALSO p has Last LastMd md AND ALSO is api of PlayerAttribute a has PlayerAttributeDate md AND ALSO a has PlayerAttributeDefensiveWorkRate: 'medium' WHERE year(b) >= 1990 AND year(b) <= 1995), 2)
note: Most recent record with low/medium/high grade; result 180.85.

answer: LIST round(THE AVERAGE w IN Player [is api of PlayerAttribute has PlayerAttributePreferredFoot: 'left'] has PlayerWeight w, 1)
note: Ambiguous: many players have both left and right on different records; I took players ever recorded left, one weight per player (166.6).

answer: LIST k FROM DISTINCT Team [has TeamShortName: 'POR'] [is home api of Match has Country has CountryName: 'England'] is api of TeamAttribute a has TeamAttributeDate d AND ALSO a has TeamAttributeBuildUpPlayDribblingClass k WHERE starts_with(d, '2015-09-10')

LIST cn, n FROM Country c has CountryName cn AND ALSO (THE DISTINCT COUNT OF Player [has PlayerWeight w] [is home 1 of Match [has Country: !c]] OR OTHERWISE [is away 1 of Match [has Country: !c]] WHERE w >= 210) AS n
note: UNVERIFIED, does not parse: the compiler rejects the numbered readings (has home 1 Player, is home 1 of Match, etc.) in every form tried, so the 22 lineup slots cannot be reached. Intended: distinct players weighing >=210 across all 22 slots per match country, top country with ties.
